name: EndsideOut Games
description: Course and game hierarchy for authored content.

children.name: Know Your Health
children.description: Seven-module health literacy course.

children.name: Know Your Health Set 1
children.description: One game from each Know Your Health module.

children.name: Sometimes or Anytime?
children.description: Drag each food to the right group — treat foods vs. foods you can eat anytime!

children.name: Added vs. Natural Sugar
children.description: Natural sugar or added sugar? Eat more or less? Answer different questions each round!

children.name: Help Flame-man!
children.description: Help our superhero make smart choices for his brain health across 5 real-life scenarios!

children.name: Fill the Glass!
children.description: Answer questions about water and healthy drinks to fill up the glass — every correct answer adds water!

children.name: Finish the Race!
children.description: Answer questions about healthy habits and race to the finish line — every correct answer moves your runner closer!

children.name: Guard Your Health!
children.description: Let good habits fall on you and drag bad habits away — protect your body from disease!

children.name: Positive or Negative?
children.description: Read body image statements and decide if each one is positive or negative — build a healthy self-image!

children.name: 3D Wellness
children.description: Eight-dimension wellness course.

children.name: 3D Wellness Set 1
children.description: One game from each wellness dimension.

children.name: Principle of Relationship
children.description: Match relationship principles and discover the building blocks of healthy connections!

children.name: Emotional Detective
children.description: Identify emotions in real-life scenarios and build emotional intelligence!

children.name: Eco Sort Challenge
children.description: Sort items into eco-friendly categories and protect the planet!

children.name: Budgeting Jars
children.description: Learn smart money management by sorting coins into the right jars!

children.name: Study Habits Sort
children.description: Sort good and bad study habits to build smarter learning routines!

children.name: Dream Job Builder
children.description: Explore careers and build your dream job path step by step!

children.name: Healthy Plate Builder
children.description: Build a balanced meal by placing foods in the right sections of the plate!

children.name: Surya Namaskar
children.description: Follow the sun salutation sequence and find your inner calm!
